newsitem.title: ST VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES: CRICKET-PUSHPAKUMARA BLITZES WINDIES WITH FIVE WICKETS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PUSHPAKUMARA BLITZES WINDIES WITH FIVE WICKETS.

text.p: Sri Lanka, inspired by pace bowler Ravindra Pushpakumara's five-wicket haul, bowled out West Indies for 147 before tea on the opening day of the second test on Friday.
Sri Lankan openers Sanath Jayasuriya and Roshan Mahanama rubbed salt into the home team's wounds by reaching 27 for no wicket off six overs by the end of the second session.

Pushpakumara, 21, who took two wickets off consecutive balls in the day's second over, finished with five for 41 off 12.4 lively overs to raise Sri Lanka's hopes of squaring the two-match series. They lost the first test in Antigua by six wicekts.
Pushpakumara received admirable support from off-spinner Muttiah Muralitharan, who took three for 28 off 12 probing overs.
West Indies, at one stage five for three, were indebted to Carl Hooper for saving them for further embarrassment.
He struck a fine 81 before falling to Pushpakumara. Hooper batted for 165 minutes, faced 118 balls and struck 10 fours and a six before he was eighth out.
